A '''Mossy Seed''' is a [[Trees|tree]] seed that grows into one of the [[Green Rain Trees|Green Rain Tree]] variants. Mossy Seeds can be obtained by shaking (5% chance) or chopping (5% chance) down a Green Rain Tree, including trees which temporarily become a Green Rain Tree during Fall & Winter or the [[Weather#Green Rain|Green Rain]] event.<ref name="treechance" /> They can also be obtained by breaking [[Weeds#Special Weeds|Large Weeds]] during the Green Rain event (5% chance).<ref name="weedchance" /> 

An unfertilised Mossy Seed has approximately a 20% chance to grow to the next stage each night during [[Spring]], [[Summer]], or [[Fall]]. There are 5 stages of growth in total. The median time to maturity is about 18 days, with over 90% of seeds maturing in less than 32 growing days.

The use of [[Tree Fertilizer]] guarantees growth by one stage each night, including during [[Winter]].
